newsitem.title: UK: L-Bank to issue euro eurobonds in francs and marks.
newsitem.headline: L-Bank to issue euro eurobonds in francs and marks.

text.p: Baden Wuerttemberg L-Finance NV will shortly launch two seven-year Eurobonds, for 2.0 billion French francs and 750 million marks, which will be redenominated in euros after EMU, joint lead manager J.P. Morgan said.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is the other joint lead manager of the mark deal. Caisse des Depots et Consignations is joint lead on the French franc bond.
Both deals, which will be guaranteed by L-Bank, will have identical terms except for the currency of issue and issue price.
They will be fungible after EMU, creating a euro Eurobond.
